expectation.note: Fires at :00 and :35 of every hour — NOT every 35 minutes.

normative_evidence.quote: steps are evaluated just within the field they are applied to

rationale: The most-reported cron misunderstanding, and one the man page actually settles. It is NORMATIVE, and it is also the vector that proves cron cannot express 'every N minutes' for N not dividing 60.
title: */35 in the minute field: step does not mean interval
